test_select_multi_camera_by_site.title: The group row's hover checkbox starts the group's cameras

steps.action: Click LPR in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: The LPR camera page opens with empty tiles that read Drag & Drop Camera here.
The panel opens and lists the configured test site.
The All Cameras group row shows under the site.

steps.action: Hover the group row and click its checkbox.
steps.expected: At least one new stream starts in a tile.

test_drag_drop_camera_to_grid.title: Dragging the group onto a tile starts its cameras

steps.action: Click LPR in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: The LPR camera page opens with empty tiles that read Drag & Drop Camera here.

steps.action: Click the Locations & Cameras header, then click the test site.
steps.expected: The All Cameras group row shows under the site.

steps.action: Drag the All Cameras group row onto the last empty tile.
steps.expected: At least one camera of the group starts streaming in a tile.

test_hover_and_select_single_camera.title: A camera row's hover checkbox starts that camera

steps.action: Click LPR in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: The LPR camera page opens with empty tiles that read Drag & Drop Camera here.

steps.action: Click the Locations & Cameras header, click the test site, then click the All Cameras group.
steps.expected: The configured test camera row shows under the group.

steps.action: Hover the camera row and click its checkbox.
steps.expected: The camera starts streaming in a tile.
